summary: Bulacan 1st District representative with 6 principal-authored bills: a revised Labor Code, estate tax amnesty extension, procurement act amendment, anti-dynasty ban, disinformation penalties and a constitutional convention. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Direction of the revised Labor Code and procurement amendment was not reviewed; remaining items are single-issue per dimension.
